before-skippy-and-the-mogres.player: Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.

before-skippy-and-the-mogres.npc: Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...

options.text: I'm sure I would as well.

steps.player: I'm sure I would as well.
I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.

steps.npc: Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!

steps.player: Who are
(Dramatic pause)
THEY?

steps.npc: They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...

steps.player: And what do THEY look like?

steps.npc: Mudskippers!

steps.player: Mudskippers?

steps.npc: Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!

steps.player: I...see...

steps.npc: I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.

steps.player: These would be the mudskippers, right?

steps.npc: Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!

steps.player: This is fascinating, but I have to be...

steps.npc: Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!

steps.player: Fires of hell...right. I believe you.

steps.npc: No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?

steps.player: Get what?

steps.text: Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!

steps.player: Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?

steps.npc: I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...

steps.player: Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.

steps.npc: You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.

steps.player: 'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?

steps.npc: It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!

steps.player: Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.

before-skippy-and-the-mogres-trying-to-s.player: You know, I could shock him out of it if I could find some cold water...

after-skippy-and-the-mogres.player: How do I annoy the Mogres again?

after-skippy-and-the-mogres.npc: Go south to Mudskipper Point and lob a Fishing Explosive into the sea. You can grab them from the Slayer masters.

after-skippy-and-the-mogres.player: Thanks! So, what are you going to do now?

after-skippy-and-the-mogres.npc: Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.

after-skippy-and-the-mogres.player: I was planning on wandering up and down the landscape, bugging people to see if they had mindblowingly dangerous quests for me to undertake.

after-skippy-and-the-mogres-when-using-t.player: I think he's sober enough. And I don't want to use another bucket of water.

when-using-a-forlorn-boot-on-skippy.npc: Thanks! Now I have two right boots!
